easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat.
